what: The plan says to add test-check-contains-pins to the test-harnesses aggregate even though that aggregate is only supposed to list test-harnesses-N shard targets
scenario_or_breakage: make test-harness-shards-coverage will report test-check-contains-pins as an unexpected aggregate prerequisite, so make lint / local test-harnesses can fail after the PR lands
suggested_fix: Do not add the individual harness to Makefile:47; add it only to .PHONY, its recipe, and exactly one test-harnesses-N shard
